editorial_intro: This week brings an exciting mix of new releases, especially for fans of Indian cinema. Highlights include the heartwarming family film 'Ohh My Dog' and the thrilling series 'Reporting Live', both available on JioHotstar. Additionally, major global titles like 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' and 'Animals' are sure to capture the attention of the diaspora.

picks.title: Ohh My Dog
picks.synopsis: In 'Ohh My Dog', a young boy named Arjun forms an unbreakable bond with a stray dog he rescues from the streets. As they navigate the challenges of life together, they inspire those around them to embrace love and compassion. The film explores themes of friendship and loyalty in a heartwarming narrative.
picks.why_watch: This film is a delightful watch for families, showcasing the beautiful bond between humans and animals, with Pankaj Tripathi delivering a heartfelt performance.

picks.title: Reporting Live
picks.synopsis: Parineeti Chopra stars as a determined journalist who uncovers a conspiracy within the sand-mining underworld. As she delves deeper, she faces threats to her life and must navigate a web of deceit to expose the truth. The series highlights the dangers faced by those who dare to speak out.
picks.why_watch: With gripping storytelling and a strong lead performance, this series is a must-watch for anyone who loves a good thriller based on real-world issues.

picks.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
picks.synopsis: This Malayalam romantic comedy follows Ashley, who returns from abroad only to find old feelings resurfacing when a wedding takes place next door. As she navigates her emotions, she must confront her past and decide what she truly wants in life.
picks.why_watch: This film offers a charming mix of romance and humor, making it a perfect light-hearted watch for the weekend.

picks.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
picks.synopsis: In this latest installment, Tom Holland returns as Spider-Man, facing new challenges as he navigates his dual life as a high school student and a superhero. With a new villain threatening New York City, Peter Parker must gather his allies and confront his fears to save the day.
picks.why_watch: This film promises thrilling action sequences and a heartfelt story, making it a must-watch for superhero fans and the Spider-Man franchise.

picks.title: Animals
picks.synopsis: Ben Affleck stars in this poignant drama that explores the complexities of human-animal relationships through the eyes of a troubled young man who finds solace in caring for stray animals. As he confronts his own demons, he learns valuable lessons about love and responsibility.
picks.why_watch: With a powerful performance by Affleck, this film is both heartwarming and thought-provoking, making it a standout in this week's releases.

picks.title: The Kardashians Season 8
picks.synopsis: The Kardashians return for another season, offering an inside look at their glamorous lives, personal struggles, and family dynamics. This season delves deeper into their relationships and the challenges they face in the public eye.
picks.why_watch: Fans of the franchise will enjoy the latest drama and developments in the lives of one of the most famous families in the world.

picks.title: Carrie
picks.synopsis: This adaptation of Stephen King's classic novel follows Carrie, a high school girl with telekinetic powers, who faces bullying from her peers. As her powers grow, so does her desire for revenge, leading to a shocking climax at the prom.
picks.why_watch: This chilling retelling captures the essence of the original while adding modern twists, making it a thrilling watch for horror fans.

picks.title: The Invite
picks.synopsis: A group of friends reunites for a dinner party that takes a dark turn when secrets are revealed and tensions rise. As the night progresses, they must confront their pasts and the consequences of their actions, leading to a shocking conclusion.
picks.why_watch: This film is a gripping psychological thriller that keeps you on the edge of your seat with its unexpected twists and turns.
